text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which means goals that are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. Breaking a project into milestones helps the team track progress and stay motivated along the way. Deliverables should also be clearly defined so everyone knows what needs to be completed. Finally, stakeholder alignment is crucial: make sure everyone involved agrees on the goals from the start. This prevents misunderstandings later and keeps the whole team moving in the same direction toward a successful result.
